title: rusolve.error/1
description: A typed model error printed on stdout with --format json when a command refuses a model it could solve wrongly (exit code 3). Router: a class no engine solves yet (kind unsupported_class; class is the router class name: nonconvex_qp, miqp, nonconvex_qcqp, mi_conic or gc_quadratic; reason says why; convexity is set for a quadratic class). The QP front's own refusals (nonconvex_quadratic_objective: Q's smallest eigenvalue, or the largest for a maximisation, and the variables it lives on; miqp_unsupported) are reached only when the router is bypassed, and carry the QPLIB code as class. The message is the stderr text.

diagnostics.description: The same refusal as registered diagnostics (rusolve.diagnostics/1 objects, one RS0012 for an unsupported class), so a client reads one shape on every error path. Additive: absent on the QP front's own refusals.

class.description: The router class name for unsupported_class (nonconvex_qp, miqp, nonconvex_qcqp, mi_conic, gc_quadratic); the QPLIB-style code for the QP front's own kinds.
